title: Randomized Multicentric Proof-of-Concept Phase 2 Trial Doravirine in the Early Outpatient Management of West Nile Virus Infection in Patients at Risk of Progression - DORICO Trial
official: Randomized Multicentric Proof-of-Concept Phase 2 Trial Doravirine in the Early Outpatient Management of West Nile Virus Infection in Patients at Risk of Progression - DORICO Trial
summary: Main objective: Reduction of the time required for a 4-fold decline in viremia in patients with WNV infection and risk factors for progression through the use of doravirine.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years
2. Confirmed diagnosis of WNV infection
3. Presence of at least one risk factor for progression to WNND
4. Signed informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Age < 18 years
2. Absence of risk factors for progression to WNND
3. Lack of informed consent
4. Concomitant treatment with carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, rifampicin, rifapentine, St. John’s Wort (Hypericum perforatum), mitotane, enzalutamide, or lumacaftor
sponsor: Azienda Socio Sanitaria Territoriale Degli Spedali Civili Di Brescia
